desc:
The clock is at twelve minutes to midnight. Make it count.

Found your nation, grow it across a living world map, and fight your way up the arms race: from tactical warheads to ICBMs, MIRVs and orbital strikes. Nuclear stockpiles and detonations move the Doomsday Clock closer to midnight. Strike midnight and a nuclear winter ends the war for everyone in mutually assured destruction.

• Real-time territory strategy for up to 100 commanders
• Research weapons and the defences against them: SAMs, radar, ABM sites, lasers
• Sign alliances and truces, or break them when it suits you
• Public, Teams, Watch, and private matches with your own rules
